title: Game X benchmark baseline — September 29, 2026 (America/New_York)
scope: Observational baseline only. Application files unchanged. Browser writes only to one disposable emulator document. Production requests only to public Hosting assets.

core.method: Serial Node CPU samples. Two discarded warmups per case; preparation outside timer. No DOM, network, or human confirmation time. Save-check cases include page-level repeated reconciliation, but exclude widget refresh and persistence.

staticNetwork.method: Node fetch, serial requests, first GET then five conditional GETs. Shared connection pool; no browser parsing, authentication, character database calls, or concurrency.

exclusions.reason: Calibration: no-op attribute restoration after fill did not emit a native change.
Overlapping input: the next action started before the second animation frame.
Partner of the overlapping input; excluded from isolated-action summaries.

browser.phaseNote: The first benchmark tab crashed during the first Techniques save. Fresh tabs in the same in-app browser then ran faster. The reason for the difference is unconfirmed; phases must not be pooled or treated as an optimization.

failures.outcome: Tab crash; no Saved completion sample. A 55-second result wait expired. Emulator revision remained 28 with five techniques and 76 HP. No reliable crash duration or cause established.
